mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and increasing equity valuations, driving positive 20-day forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.3% in 3 months signals weakening labor market confidence, leading to reduced growth expectations and negative 20-day forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive despite UNRATE crossing threshold, or rate doesn't sustain rise.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices above their 2% quarterly growth thresholds signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive 60-day forward S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase >2% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both proxies rising, or one proxy doesn't meet threshold.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate remains below 1% and demand (GDPC1) grows by over 5% in a month, accommodative monetary policy and strong demand create favorable conditions for positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS <1% and GDPC1 increases >5% in 1 month
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS doesn't stay below 1% or GDPC1 doesn't rise sufficiently, or returns not positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, elevated demand (GDPC1) does not translate to sustained S&P 500 forward returns due to market overvaluation concerns, predicting negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive despite high GDPC1 in late-cycle, or regime not active.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly inflation rate above 2.0% signals tight monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and driving negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: inflation doesn't hit threshold or returns positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden 20% increase in jobless claims (PAYEMS) over a month signals weakening labor market confidence, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: returns positive despite high PAYEMS spike, or spike doesn't precede downturn.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.0% alongside rising demand (GDPC1) creates a favorable labor market and economic expansion, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls >0.2pp and GDPC1 rises >3% in 3 months
regime_hint: improving labor market and strong demand
failure_condition: interaction not strong enough (e.g., one doesn't meet threshold) or returns negative.
